source_text:
[i_PI_AncientTome]Journal Page 15
The shrines are deteriorating so quickly that they will be completely tapped before the day is out.  I must find a way to stop the praetox horde, yet it is far too numerous for me to openly confront alone...

[i_PI_Aldus]Journal Page 21
The outcasts have been trailing me since the first shrine in Lightfall Grove.  I do not sense them to be a threat.  I would reason to guess that they are concerned for their well being, as I am concerned for Aven's.

Journal Page 25
An enchanting young outcast woman came to my campfire this evening.  Tael is her name.  She spoke of ancient legends belonging to her people; tales of an ancient city and people charged with the defense of creation itself.  These were beautiful and amazing stories and I cannot help but feel enlightened by them...

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]Well, Guardian, you certainly have earned your title today. So much for an easy life of gambling.

No, forgive me. That was uncalled for. Your deeds speak for themselves.

My sharp tongue gets away from me sometimes. I'm sorry.

In any event, you were quite remarkable.  I didn't expect so much from you.

Still, it seems that our ceremonial positions may have become... a bit more real.  Well, at least yours has.  I've yet to find out how I can be of any real help in our current situation.  All I've done is cause grief and trouble by being abducted.

You know, it was strange now that I think back on it.

That monster you slew... it kept talking to my shadow.

A whole crazy conversation!  Gibberish! And worse...

Sometimes I thought I understood it.

Never mind all that now.  It wasn't supposed to be like this.  The emergency isn't over yet.

Overseer Lysetta needs your help. She was bitten too... she seems hurt worse than I am.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]Guardian! It is time to put your warrior skills to the test.

This is why we select a Guardian every year, even though it has been centuries since there was a need.

Kaylee, my most brilliant protégée and the elected Crown of Aven, has been abducted.

She was last seen in Market Plaza and I suspect she has been taken into the Secret Catacombs.

Move quickly, Guardian!  It is your sworn duty to protect the Crown.

This stone will help you brave the darkness.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysettaSick]Guardian... I brewed a serum while you were in the catacombs.  It isn't much, and certainly not a cure, but it has alleviated the pain and much of the numbing confusion of the affliction.  However, I fear that our time is running dangerously thin.

My research has revealed a possible lead to our quest for a more permanent cure to our ailment.

But this good news comes with its own taint of sour, I'm afraid.

A messenger came from the Howling Pine not so long ago.  Willam, the barkeep, reports they are under praetox attack again!

Our lair...  I mean.  The praetox...    the praetox lair must be beneath the inn.

The catacombs there have been forbidden to citizens of Aven for many decades. Perhaps now we know why.

If the nest is there, as I suspect, you should find a praetox queen.

The only hope of brewing an antidote requires a sample of her venom.

Do you understand, Guardian? If what I have read is true, we do not have much time. The poisonous bites act swiftly and my serum will not help for long.

Did you see how Kaylee scratched at her bitten arm? It will worsen. 

Bring the venom of the praetox queen, for her sake. May your strength carry you swiftly.

source_text: Athloxxia, the queen of the praetox horde, is dead.  I managed to gather a small sample of her venom in a glass vial -- I spilled some of it on my armor in the process and it sizzled like acid.  Fortunately, it did not burn its way through to my skin...  I had best get this stuff to Lysetta at once.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysettaSick]Guardian! The venom? You have it?

Yes... with this, I am sure I can fashion an antidote. Leave me to it, while I can still focus.  Rest assured, Guardian.  I am confident that I can prevent any permanent damage from being inflicted upon either Kaylee or myself...

You should make sure there are no more praetox spiders roaming about--we will not have much antivenin, so if more folk are bitten...

Also, Elder Aidas has requested your presence. Have you met him?

He is the head of the druids of Aven. No, I do not know why he asks for you. I suggest you see for yourself.

Now, please excuse me.  I must work quickly for the sake of Kaylee... and myself.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysettaSick]Guardian, while you were rescuing our Crown from that...  creature, we were attacked again.

I'm afraid I was bitten by a dark praetox not unlike the one you dispatched in the Howling Pine.

The toxin is like nothing I've seen before. And this illness... it is unique.

I do not think it merely causes death, but something more sinister. That shadowy spider reeked of the eldritch.

The dark praetox fled into the Western Catacombs.  I need you to pursue it.  Try to locate the nest.

Be careful.  The Western Catacombs are said to be cursed.  Bring back any clues you find!

I'll continue my research here and should fate prove to be on our side, we'll find a cure before it is too late.

Pfaugh! You're nothing but the winner of a pointless contest of arms.

source_text:

The folk beyond the walls of Aven are little more than savages. We are the greatest city in the world, the city on the clouds.

We deserve our pre-eminence.

[i_PI_MadamDiana]I wish that Draven would ease his grasp on the city gates.

He needs to let my scouts do what it is they do best--scout the outer territories.

He has this misguided view that all beyond the walls is waste and barbarism.

But we have ventured far enough to know that there are other civilized people out there, for all we call them wildlings and outcasts.

Draven is a closed-minded idiot. Who knows what we might learn from those people?

There are many dangers lurking in the unexplored shadows of our world.

The wildling folk are skittish, and will not speak to strangers, but be aware that they will be watching you.

Now I must remain here. Coordinating. I feel so helpless.

Listen--there is a pathway leading to the Western Catacombs near the marketplace.

Go quickly and show those beasts no mercy! Kill some for me.

Tend the Shrines

source_text: Gorgein shamans have begun seeping the magic from the druid shrines in the forest territories.  Elder Aidas has asked me to investigate the forest territories and stop the gorgein before they can complete their plan.  However, I must first gain the proper permissions to leave the city proper, and Sir Armon takes his job a little too seriously.  I hope this goes smoothly...

source_text:
[i_PI_Aidas]It is rare for someone to rise up and so selflessly take action as you have done in these past hours.

However, it is not on the subject of your bravery that I wish to speak. 

Many centuries ago, the ancient druids erected three shrines in the woodlands.

These shrines have protected the forest from corruption for many centuries.

Today, I feel their magic waning.

If these shrines are destroyed, the forest will be vulnerable to the pollution of our world.

Madam Diana has been very gracious in lending her scouts to this plight.

They have discovered that gorgein shamans are leeching the magic from the shrines -- for what purpose, I do not know.

The gorgein are a twisted race of cannibalistic boar-men that have lived in the wilds for centuries, but have never before confronted us in this manner.

You must find the gorgein shamans and stop them before they tap all magic from the shrines.

I have already spoken with Sir Armon at the gates and he has assured me that you may leave the city for this task.

source_text:
[i_PI_Aidas]The magical wards have begun to stabilize.  I and my coven thank you, young hero.

I will speak with the Templar on the matter of the gorgein activities.  It is most curious that these beings would suddenly turn hostile, considering we have coexisted for eras.  

Unfortunately, I believe that this is not the last we have heard of the gorgein movement. 

I will also take the transcripts you found to Overseer Lysetta for further study.  The similarities between this historical document and our current dilemma are both curious and troubling.

I feel as if there is a darker meaning to our recent misfortunes; something is driving Unataca's inhabitants into madness.  It certainly seems as if new enemies are appearing at every turn.

For now, accept my most sincere and humble gratitude.  My coven has blessed this item for your service.  It will aid you well in the coming battles.

source_text:
[i_PI_KayleeSickly]Guardian... welcome. I knew you would survive.

The Overseer was able to brew a serum... it has helped, but we aren't well yet.

I feel like I am spending my life asking for help, rather than giving it. But still, I must ask--

The wildling outcasts broke into our city and stole away with the crystal we need to distill the venom for the antidote.

You can imagine that Draven is ready to lead an army to burn the lot of the wildlings folk out of the forest. He has never liked the wildling folk, but we are not out to seek vengeance.  All we need is the distilling crystal to be returned and nothing more.

The guards saw the old woman who stole the artifact flee back toward the Shadowpine.  We don't know why she took it, unless the wildlings are in league with the enemy.

I am asking you to recover the distilling crystal from the outcasts.  Please, make haste. Overseer Lysetta is fading. I'm doing better, I think.

Recover the Distilling Crystal

source_text: The wildling outcasts broke into the Academy and stole the distilling crystal that the Overseer needs to create a cure.  What the outcasts want with the crystal is unimportant!  I must find them in the Shadowpine and recover what they stole.

structural_fields.english_text: The wildling outcasts broke into the Academy and stole the distilling crystal that the Overseer needs to create a cure.  What the outcasts want with the crystal is unimportant!  I must find them in the Shadowpine and recover what they stole.

source_text:
[i_PI_OldWoman]So you arrogant Avenites come to slay us now? You were always ready to look down on us...

Before you bloody your hands--Wait! We know why you have come, but you must hear us out!  Yes, we stole the crystal, but only for the sake of my granddaughter.

The gorgein came to us the night past and stole away with my granddaughter.  They told me that if I wanted to see her again, we had to take something from the Academy in your city.

We knew full well that you Avenites have forgotten your ancient role and forgotten your ties of blood with us. You never would have given us the distilling crystal.

It is hidden somewhere safe; the gorgein have yet to claim it. Save my granddaughter and you can have it back. I swear it.

Our scouts followed the gorgein's tracks to the Bleak Mines. If you are willing to help me, please...

The thought of losing my granddaughter, my only heir... oh, please hurry.

source_text:
[i_PI_OldWoman]Thank you for this.  As was my part of the bargain, here is the crystal.

I am surprised by you--you folks of Aven are always looking down on us, sneering at us, calling us names.

You call us wildlings or outcasts or worse, and think we are savages. But perhaps Aven has recovered its soul at last.

Hopefully you can now carry back word to your city in the clouds that we are not mad or savage--we are just trying to live here in troubled times.

It has been two hundred years since we gave one of our own to you--you must know the story--and still you ignore us.

One would almost think that you Avenites have forgotten your high purpose and your calling, the reason your city exists.

Before you go, a word of caution.  We know that something dark is brewing between the gorgein tribes.  The people of your city are not as safe as you would perceive yourselves to be.

With that, I and my people will leave you to your duties.  Do not fail in them.  For all our sakes, Aven must not fail.

[i_PI_KayleeSickly]What could the gorgein want with the distilling crystal?  This is both disturbing and puzzling.

We are now able to pursue a cure for the venom infecting the Overseer and me...

I am most curious about the old woman's words, however.

Aven's purpose? I don't know of any purpose the city has. And what wildling was given to us?

Perhaps we have been too quick to judge those outside our walls--it sounds like they have much to teach us.

[i_PI_KayleeSickly]Guardian. It is good to see you again. I have a question for you...

Tell me, did you dream? Before these attacks?

I have come to realize that since being crowned, I have had dreams of dark places, filled with shuffling sounds...

I wonder now if they were premonitions of the evil that has come upon us.

I haven't told anyone else of this--they would think me mad--but I thought that since you are like me, maybe you...

Never mind.

The Elder seemed both intrigued and concerned while he was speaking with the Overseer.  I think that the Elder wishes to speak with you regarding your find.

Instigate the Uprising

source_text: Madam Diana has devised a cunning plan that is sure to give us the upper hand against the gorgein.  All I have to do is go into the topmost level of the Wallowpit in Tornwood Forest and slay Marrowtusk, the gorgein tribe's most skilled warrior...  Well, she didn't say that it would be easy.

source_text:
[i_PI_MadamDiana]I have a most... important use for your talents, young hero.  I promise, this mission will be worthy of your time and cunning.
[p]
The activities of the Wallowpit tribe suggest nothing less than a planned assault on our city.
[p]
As we are still recovering from the earlier and unexpected praetox invasion, we cannot afford to let the gorgein plans come to fruition. 
[p]
We need a distraction that will delay the gorgein plans and give us time to gather our strength.
[p]
 Fortunately for us, we do not stand alone amidst this tribe's contingent of enemies.
[p]
Those gorgein known as the Snoutrotts are formidable opponents to the matriarch's rule and it would be in our interests if the two were to violently clash. 
[p]
Go to the Wallowpit and kill their champion warrior, Marrowtusk.   You will then go to the Snoutrott Den and annihilate their leader, Krelgaak Snoutrott, and plant the evidence of an assassination by the Wallowpit tribe.
[p]
Chaos will then ravage the two tribes, giving us the time we need to prepare for an attack.

I am certain that Templar Draven would agree.

[p]
Perhaps humans are stronger than anticipated, but the gorgein do not fear you!  The gorgein will not be so easily squashed as bugs under foot!  Soon, gorgein will reign over human city!  Soon, gorgein will feast on human flesh!  
[p]
Nothing can save stupid humans from us now.  Time of humans is over!  Time of gorgein has come!

source_text: The Overseer has requested that I speak with Elder Aidas regarding an urgent matter.  It would be foolish to delay any further.

source_text:
[i_PI_Aidas]Whilst the Overseer searches for a cure, she has asked for my assistance in deciphering the prophecy you uncovered.

I am woe to say that the prophecy does not speak well of coming events.  We are faced against a great evil and the praetox and gorgein aggressions were only the beginning.

However, all is not lost for us.  The ancient prophecy uncovered in your tome speaks of four relics that will play an integral role in the coming chaos.  I have confidence in you, young hero, and so I entrust unto you this task.

I believe that my order may be safeguarding an artifact of great significance to this prophecy. We must study the wreath, but neither I nor my coven will dare retrieve it from the sacred site.

I wish for you to retrieve this artifact from the Sacred Vaults.  Be wary when you enter, for the undying spirits of our ancient order guard the Vaults to this day.  The being known as the Rotting Priest is the keeper of the relic.

I trust that you will not disturb our sacred earth more than you must to perform this task.

source_text:
After trekking through the dank and horrid depths of the ancient burial grounds and defeating the undying lord of the Sacred Vaults, you have finally obtained the ancient druidic relic.
[p]
It is a beautiful wreath of lush vines with fragrant flowers.  Beads of dew still cling to the leaves and petals adorning the sacred object.
[p]
Now that the relic is in hand, you feel it is urgent to take it to the Elder before it is damaged or worse, claimed by Aven's enemies.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I have briefly studied the tome you recovered from the Western Catacombs and it has revealed some most intriguing things.

The tome was written two centuries ago by a historian named Aldus.  According to Aldus' text, Aven once experienced a rising chaos that curiously mirrors the turmoil of the recent days.

My illness and dire need for a cure has prevented me from studying the tome any further.  Elder Aidas has been most gracious in lending me his wisdom on the matter and has taken over study of the tome. 

I want you to speak with Elder Aidas.  I believe your services will be most helpful in our further quest for the truth.

source_text:
[i_PI_Aidas]Yes, this is indeed the Wreath of Continuance -- one of four tools used by a once forgotten order known as the Brotherhood of the Blade.

In a time when Aven was young, four heroes forged this sacred union to defend Aven and her people from an ancient threat. I am still trying to piece together all of the facts, but I can say with confidence that this brotherhood was a benevolent yet powerful force.

It is written in the prophecy that the Tools of the Four--sacred artifacts, one of which we now possess--are the key to our survival.  I will inform the Overseer of this triumph at once.

It is evident that we must continue to pursue the remaining three artifacts, however, I wish more time to study the Brotherhood.  Rushing into this task without certainty could prove disastrous.

In the meantime, you had best report to Templar Draven.  He sent an urgent request for your services while you were engaged in the vaults.

[i_PI_DeanLysetta]Templar Draven has asked me to direct you to Madam Diana.

It would seem that they need your assistance protecting the city from another threat.

source_text: [i_PI_DeanLysetta]The Templar is looking for you, hero.  Considering the current state of the gorgein tribes, I would heed this call post haste.

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]The gorgein have everyone so concerned!  I think it would help us all if you were to lend your assistance to Madam Diana and put a stop to this rising threat.
[p]
It must feel good to be so useful. These days, I feel as if I am nothing more than a wall against which our enemies are battering.
[p]
Perhaps if you are Aven's sword, I am its armor.

[i_PI_GoodKaylee]I do appreciate how you make time to speak with me, Guardian. I feel as if we have come to a special understanding of one another.
[p]
The gorgein may be weakened as they fight one another, but it's only a matter of time before their rage is focused on us once again.
[p]
Templar Draven has a plan, I am sure.  Have you spoken with him?

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]We're all so eager to learn if the Elder's suspicions are true!
[p]
I feel as if we are close to unraveling this mystery. Have I told you, my dreams have changed?
[p]
In them, I see four, sometimes six shining figures, circling me as I sleep. Two of them clasp hands. It feels as if they were guarding me.
[p]
Then it turns to nightmare as I realize they are indeed guards--facing in! Guarding the world from me.
[p]
What can it mean?

source_text: Yet another enemy is challenging us!  It seems that the whole world is out to get us!  I must learn more about the vrultok threat from Madam Diana.  Perhaps I will be able to lend my aid once again to the defense of Aven and my brethren.

source_text:
[i_PI_MadamDiana]My scouts have located the encampment of the vrultok general leading the assault on the Marrowrock Gates. You must act quickly and eliminate the general and his guards before they breach our defenses.

You must take this with you.  It will help you safely pass through the otherwise deadly pit in the northern Marrowrock caverns.

Go now, hero.  The spirit of the wild will guide you to victory.

Go now, hero.  The spirit of the wild will guide you to victory.

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]We are once again in danger of being overrun by war and savagery.

I have received reports that enemies from the Badlands have amassed their numbers for an invasion of Aven and her territories.

I cannot afford to dispatch my knights into the badlands as doing so would leave us defenseless against other attacks.

The tribe that attacks us is known as the vrultok. Little is known of them--even the outcasts avoid them.

You must report to Madam Diana.  Her berserkers have returned with intelligence of the vrultok's movements and we will need your assistance to fend off this foe.

source_text: I must stop the vrultok general and his armies in Deadeye Ridge before they breach our borders.  Madam Diana gave me a rope so that I can climb down the pit in Marrowrock North in Lightfall Grove.  I must then make my way through Marrowrock South in order to reach Deadeye Ridge.

source_text: The general has been slain, but I don't think that the vrultok will be so easily convinced to stop their attacks against us.  It is best that I return to Madam Diana and see what plans she and the Templar have come up with.

source_text:
[i_PI_MadamDiana]The vrultok are enemies we have never engaged in open warfare before.

I have lost scouts to them in the passing years, but this assault was unseen by even my watchful eye.  It is curious that they attack so suddenly after the gorgein's defeat...

Perhaps Draven's earlier paranoia was not unfounded.

But no matter, you performed quite masterfully against this unpredictable enemy, my young Guardian.  I want you to have this. It will serve you well in the battles to come.

Now, go quickly to Draven.  I can personally attest to his... impatience with those who do not heed his beck and call.

Destroy the Stronghold

source_text: I must find the vrultok stronghold called Ironstone Hollow in the Deadeye Ridge and put a stop to the stronghold's construction by killing the active general on the site.

structural_fields.english_text: I must find the vrultok stronghold called Ironstone Hollow in the Deadeye Ridge and put a stop to the stronghold's construction by killing the active general on the site.

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]We have learned that the vrultok are constructing a citadel called Ironstone Hollow in the caverns of Deadeye Ridge.

It is imperative to our survival that they not be allowed to erect a stronghold so close to our borders.

You must stop this construction and slay the enemy there.  Kill the vrultok general at the site and you will halt their progress long enough for us to plan our next move.

Now go.  We cannot spare a single moment as war approaches our front door.

source_text: The stronghold's construction has been halted and the forces there eliminated.  It's only a matter of time before the vrultok resume their work.  I must return to Templar Draven at once.  There is no time to spare.

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]You have performed most admirably, young Guardian.  Smiths in the Shaelunn Maul have forged this in honor of your service and dedication to the people of Aven.  Use it well.

The vrultok have been hindered, but we will not enjoy the spoils of this victory for long.  We must still prepare for their next strike.

Until that inevitable time arises, you are to report to Overseer Lysetta.  She possesses the details of your next assignment.

source_text: I must travel through the Shattercove West in Tornwood Forest.  Once I make my way through Shattercove West and East, I will reach Splinterfull Woods.  I must then make my way through the Dreadwind Moor to the Waning Wastes where the Whispering Chasm resides. There, I will find the siren known as Alyssia the Hateful.  It is from her that I will obtain the Containment Shard.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]It would seem that your actions have earned you as many enemies as they have admirers, Guardian.

It will not be long before the vrultok retaliate and we must be prepared for their arrival.

I have located a perfect reinforcement for our border and should my calculations be correct, we will be able to secure the Marrowrock gates against another attack.

I need you to go into the badlands and find the Whispering Chasm.  The sirens that live there were once contained in chambers protected by an enchanted device.  

The enchanted devices, once used to safeguard the sirens from their enemies, will also protect our gates from further attack.

I have learned from Madam Diana's scouts that the siren known as Alyssia the Hateful still retains the artifact that held her in slumber for centuries.  You must confront this powerful siren and recover the Containment Shard.

Bring the shard back to me and my acolytes will ensure that it is properly attuned for our needs.

source_text:
Kaylee has once again been abducted by our enemies.  What they want with her is insignificant compared to the importance of her safe return.

I must find the Screeching Halls in Dreadwind Moor and rescue Kaylee before it is too late.

source_text:
[i_PI_KayleeSickly]You've come...  I knew that you would...
[p]
The journal...  we cannot leave without it. You must take it to Overseer Lysetta...
[p]
And... Guardian?
[p]
Don't blame yourself for what has befallen me.  I knew the risks when I ventured onto the battlefields to help our wounded knights.  I made the choice of my own accord, as ultimately careless as it was.
[p]
I know now that I should have spoken with you before leaving the confines of the city and I am sorry that I disrespected your post, Guardian.
[p]
You need not forgive me for this, but know that I am grateful for your unwavering dedication despite my past trespass against you.

source_text:
[i_PI_AncientTome]Tael has joined me in my investigation of the coming turmoil.  She shares a very deep and personal concern for the subject of my study.  There is much I must still learn about this intriguing young woman, but she is without a doubt a most unique and inspiring woman.

[i_PI_Aldus]After nearly a fortnight of wandering, our collective efforts have recently led us to the outer regions of the Badlands.  Further investigation indicated that the vrultok, a necromantic cult of powerful warriors and sorcerers, are somehow involved.

In this assessment, we were dangerously correct.  As I write these words, Tael and I sit in a vrultok prison cell; all of our work now aiding the cruel and diabolical Nethereye seal his malevolent pact with the darkness.

Our naivety has only aided the darkness that threatens our world.  May the fates and our descendants forgive us...

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]You must forgive the Crown for her stubborn nature, Guardian.  She left without warning to anyone, even I was stunned to learn that she had left the city of her own volition.  

Understand that she was determined to lend her aid to the knights and I don't think even you could have stopped her from leaving the safety of Aven's walls.  Her intentions were noble but her method was most unwise.

However, we cannot afford to dwell on the past or hold these transgressions against her.

Kaylee is resting now.  She is physically safe and unscathed, thanks to you.  It's her mind that troubles me now.

I fear that the ordeals of the last days may prove too much for her to bear.  She is a brilliant woman, but an innocent soul.  It is this nature that Aven fell in love with and it is because of her innocence and grace that she is our Crown.

The ordeal I speak is most grim and leaves us with a degree of uncertainty for Kaylee's fate...

source_text:
Templar Draven has yet another assignment for me.  It seems that there will be no rest for the weary...

When will Aven be safe again?

structural_fields.english_text:
Templar Draven has yet another assignment for me.  It seems that there will be no rest for the weary...

When will Aven be safe again?

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]Events of the days past have left us with no alternative other than to destroy the vrultok threat immediately.

My knights are not capable of facing the Nethereye and his hordes in open warfare.  Their numbers are simply too great and I cannot risk the chance of leaving Aven undefended. 

You, however, have proven very resilient and successful in your lone endeavors against this enemy.

This is why I am charging you with this task to succeed where no one else can.

We believe the Nethereye to be stationed in Necrosis Citadel, the center of the vrultok nation.  Find him, destroy him, and return his belongings to me.

We must not only eliminate this threat, but we must learn of their connection to the aggressions of the recent past and the shadow infections plaguing the region.

I would ask that you return to me when you are prepared to once again lend me your aid.  I am certain that the treasures you have returned will uncover new leads in our quest.

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]The Crown has been abducted by the vrultok.  She fled the city walls without warning to any of us and made her way to a medical facility on the battlefront.  It was her intent to tend to my wounded soldiers, but she was quickly discovered by the vrultok armies and was abducted within hours of her arrival.

Those fortunate enough to survive the raid were either kidnapped or have since succumbed to the curse of the necromancers. 

It is clear to me that the Crown is an important asset to the vrultok's plan.  What their plan is, I neither know nor care.  The Crown's safe return is all that matters.

The vrultok have a stronghold in Dreadwind Moor known as the Screeching Halls.  According to the evidence we have gathered, this stronghold is where you will find Kaylee and her abductors.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I think it best that you are aware of exactly what is happening before the Templar sends you out on your next mission.

According to Kaylee, the chief vrultok necromancer known as the Nethereye was present throughout her short imprisonment.  She said that a dark ritual was performed and a curse was cast on her.  This curse will undoubtedly prove fatal or worse.

I had the opportunity to read the journal that you brought back from the stronghold.  Aldus' writings grant us the knowledge we need to defeat the vrultok and remove the curse that the Nethereye placed upon our Crown.

Go now to the Templar.  His next task is vital to our research and the Crown's survival.

Recover the Second

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]The entire tome you recovered from the Nethereye is a dark passage from the prophecy that speaks of corruption and a vile power.  There are many spells written amidst the prophecy and I admit that I have never seen anything like them before.

According to the journal Kaylee found during her imprisonment, the Nethereye acquired this knowledge from Aldus, who was briefly imprisoned as Kaylee was not so long ago.

The Nethereye had managed to harness some part of this power, somehow connecting himself to the greater threat lurking in our world.

It is now certain -- a vile darkness looms over our future and we must prepare ourselves for the inevitable struggle.

I have managed to uncover information that will lead us to the second tool of the Brotherhood of the Blade; the Aegis of Purity.

I need you to recover this artifact posthaste while I search the Nethereye's tome for a cure to Kaylee's curse.

The Aegis is located in the second level of the Temple of Dreams.  My research has indicated that the artifact resides in the clutches of the siren known as Acaelstra.  

We know little else about the temple and the state of its inhabitants, but it is reasonable to assume that Acaelstra and her siren sisters are most powerful.

Make haste, young hero.  Time, I fear, is a luxury we no longer possess.

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]You have helped us so much in the past, but now we face a new threat -- one that we are not prepared to fight.
[p]
Are we ever prepared for what the world may bring, I wonder?
[p]
I was a scholar, no more. Oh, I know, I was fair to look at, and everyone thinks me kind...
[p]
But really, it was studies and books that I wanted. The Academy was my home.
[p]
Now look at me. Aven elected me Crown, just as they elected you Guardian, and we weren't given any training in what might happen.
[p]
How are we supposed to know what to do?
[p]
Please, go to Templar Draven and lend him your aid.  Without you, we are lost.

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]The vrultok would surely be at our doorstep if it weren't for you, brave Guardian.  Unfortunately, there is much to be done before we are truly safe.

I have been thinking more on my dreams. Why is it that I am the one guarded against?

In my dreams, when I look at the faces of the shining figures who surround me, I could swear they seem to be grieving.

It saps my will. It makes me feel... like I am doing less than I should.

Please, show the Templar that you are still willing to fight for us.

source_text:
[i_PI_GoodKaylee]The vrultok have been hindered, but we are still vulnerable.  You must speak with the Overseer about this situation.  She needs your help.
[p]
And I... I have come to a decision. I can no longer merely cower behind these walls.
[p]
Am I Aven's Crown or not? I was elected for a reason.
[p]
I can't just stand by while you take action. I can't let my life be ruled by bad dreams.
[p]
I have volunteered my services to help the wounded. It may put me in the path of danger, but... I have to do it.
[p]
Wish me luck, Guardian. Once, I looked down on you.
[p]
Today, I find myself looking to you, as an example to follow.
[p]
Go now, to the Overseer. Go on. I will be alright.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I managed to locate the incantation used by the Nethereye to infect Kaylee.  It was difficult, but I think I was able to successfully adapt a countercurse from the tome. 

Time is growing desperately thin for our side of the coming conflict.

It is imperative that we recover the final tools of the brotherhood with all haste.  I have discovered the location of the third and I trust only you with its recovery.

The prophecies speak of a frozen wasteland somewhere on this earth.  I have located this region, but travel there will be quite dangerous.

You must find a way into the heavily guarded Dreamspace beneath the Temple of Dreams.  Travel through this ethereal realm is the only way that you can reach the tundra in time.

Once you have reached the tundra, you must find a place called the Crystal Tower.  The prophecy indicates the Salve of Regeneration is being safeguarded on the topmost level of the tower.

However, I must first make my way to the lowest level of the Temple of Dreams and confront the one known as the Dreamkeeper, for she is the guardian of the Dreamspace and she alone holds the key that will grant me passage to this ethereal realm.

The Overseer will be grateful to have it in her possession.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]The recovery of the salve brings us ever more closer to achieving our goals.

I've yet to discern the location of the final artifact, and I fear it will be some time before I reach any adequate conclusions.  There is still so much to study, so much to learn of the Brotherhood and our own past...

While I continue my research, I would ask that you speak with Madam Diana.  She is desperate for your aid.

source_text:
[i_PI_MadamDiana]Guardian, I am in desperate need of your assistance.

While you searched the tundra for the third artifact, a group of my scouts were sent to explore the unfamiliar terrain.  During this venture, they came upon the lair of an ancient beast who called himself Csuragaul.

Csuragaul has demanded an audience with our Guardian.  I don't know how this creature knows of you and your triumphs, but you are the only one who can save my scouts.

You must go to him quickly.  You will find him in his lair; the Frostwail Caverns.  Hurry, Guardian.  The fate of my sisters resides in your hands alone.

I can reach his lair of the Frostwail Caverns by traveling through the Icen Halls in the Glacial Steppes.  The Icen Halls West connect to the Gloomfall Wastes that are home to the Frostwail Cavern.

source_text:
[i_PI_Csuragual]You are the champion of Aven?  So, Aldus and Tael's efforts have not been in vain... and yet I see that you have much to learn of your purpose.

When Aldus and Tael arrived in this realm, the dark plague followed.  Lord Ashgard, the eldest of my order, was infected by the disease during his efforts to aid the scholars.

Your ancestors were innocent in this tragedy.  They fled to the Abyss when the reality of their purpose became dire, leaving us to fend alone against a powerful corruption. 

It has been two centuries since Ashgard's infection and he alone has brought our people to the brink of extinction.  As the champion of your people, you are the only one who can right what Aldus and Tael could not.

Relieve us of Lord Ashgard and in return, I will grant you the counsel Ashgard gave to your predecessors; the counsel you so desperately need to fulfill your purpose.

Go to the Shiverdark.  There, you will find the corrupted remains of Lord Ashgard.  Only when his tortured existence is at its end shall I honor my word to release your females and counsel you through these darkened times.

Csuragaul has promised to lend me his counsel, but only if I am able to vanquish the corrupted remains of Lord Ashgard.

I will be waiting your return.

Return now to Overseer Lysetta.  My scouts informed her of your dealings with Csuragaul and she wishes to speak with you on the matter.

source_text:
[i_PI_AidasConcerned]The vrultok's magic will devastate the entirety of our world if they should triumph over us.  You are our only chance for survival.

I beg of you, for the sake of all that is good and pure, lend your aid to the Templar.  Now, more than ever, we need you.

source_text:
[i_PI_Aidas]We must continue our pursuit of the prophecy.  To ignore it would to be to seal our fate in the coming darkness.

You must lend your support to the Overseer in any way that she deems necessary.  You are our champion in this cause.

source_text: [i_PI_Aidas]Madam Diana has a most intriguing task for you.  I admit, my own curiosity has been piqued by her scouts' findings.

Venture to the Abyss

source_text: The Overseer believes that we should trust Csuragaul and seek his counsel.  As I am the Guardian, it is up to me to appeal to this ancient beast and gain his trust.  I just hope that he proves to be as cooperative as he originally proclaimed himself to be.  He is waiting for me in the Frostwail Caverns beneath the Gloomfall Wastes.

source_text:
[i_PI_Csuragual]I know why you have come.  While the final tool does not reside in our realm, I can guide you to its location.

There is a distant place of fire and chaos that has been home to this ancient relic for countless generations.

The Infernal Abyss may be reached only through the Dreamspace that brought you here, but a path through madness must be traveled to the fiery realm.

This is the same path traveled by Aldus and Tael all those years ago.  What came of them on the other side is unknown to me.  It would be in your best interest to use caution and search for any clues that Tael and Aldus may have left behind.

This potion will allow you to pass into the ethereal domain of Pandemonium - the gateway to the Infernal Abyss.

Be prepared, young champion, and do not let the chaos that awaits lead you away from your destined path.

source_text: I must make my way through Pandemonium's Gate, an ethereal realm beyond the Dreamspace of the Temple of Nightmares.  Csuragual gave me an Astral Potion that will grant me passage through the chaotic space.  He has also advised that I search for any clues that Aldus and Tael may have left in the Infernal Abyss.  Their experience and the knowledge of their fate is priceless to our cause.

source_text:
The Infernal Abyss is a searing hell of volcanic earth marred by the countless trails of broiling rivers of magma.  The air itself burns your lungs and reeks with the acrid stench of sulfur.

Those beings who have survived to dominate this inhospitable landscape are undoubtedly possessed of immense power and cunning.

The journal you have found is remarkably cool to the touch--obviously, it is preserved by some magical enchantment.

The text within is unmistakably that of Aldus, making it prudent for the journal to be presented to the Overseer for further study.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I have spoken with Madam Diana's scouts regarding the dealings you had with the being called Csuragaul.

Aldus' text leads me to believe that this creature may be our only chance to recover the final artifact.

Return to Csuragaul and seek his promised counsel.  We are confident that his wisdom will recognize the vastness of the threat we all face.

Make haste, hero.  Time is of the essence; now more than ever.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]It is certain we are following Aldus' footsteps in our quest to vanquish the shadow from our realm, and yet his fate is still uncertain to us.

Despite our lack of knowledge, we must not lose focus on the task at hand.  At long last, the final artifact is within our grasp.

Within the Obsidian Caverns of the abyss resides a being known as The Oracle, a creature of immense power that was once instrumental in the incarceration of the very force behind the shadow infections spreading throughout our world.

The Oracle possesses an item of great power, the Orb of Containment, which I believe to have been used to secure the great evil from the world.

This item is the final tool of the Brotherhood and its recovery is of the utmost importance.

I do believe with a great deal of certainty that the Oracle has succumbed to the corruption of the shadow, so you must be prepared to destroy this ancient and powerful being.

Go quickly and tread with caution.  Should you perish, all will be lost.

The Overseer believes that this once ally of ours is now an enemy, leaving me with no other choice than to prepare for battle.

source_text:
[i_PI_Beholder]For generations I guarded the Shadowed God, but no longer shall I play pawn to the whims of mortals!  The greater power has shown me great things... and I have been reasoned to see the greater purpose.

Your struggle and the efforts of those before you have been in vain, foolish mortal.  The tools of the Masters can not save you now!

Look around you!  This fiery domain is the fate of your world and all your beloved.

Fight, if you will, but know that even victory will prove to be for naught against the might of the Xoquoxxotil!

It is imperative that I bring the final artifact to the Overseer so that we may prepare for the coming fight.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]Although the final tool is in our possession, we are not wholly prepared to face the shadow.  Still, fortune is with us as the battle has yet to truly begin.  Should we remain vigilant and strong, hope is not lost.

I have translated more of the prophecy and our next step has been revealed.  Templar Draven has been given a complete report of my research and he will be overseeing your next task.

Before you go, I wish for you to have this.  It has been in the possession of the Academy for countless years and I believe that it will aid you through the dangers to come.

source_text:
[i_PI_AncientTome]We prepare tonight for my venture into the five citadels.

[i_PI_Aldus]The horrors that await are beyond my comprehension, but we are undoubtedly heading into a most hazardous and dark chapter in our quest.

Should I survive the ordeal, I will be but one step closer to purging this world from the dark nemesis that threatens all life on Unataca.

After much convincing, I have reasoned with Tael and she will remain behind as the keeper and messenger of our collective findings.  If I should fail, she is the last beacon of hope for Aven.  They alone can succeed in the event of my failure else all will perish to oblivion...

Our ancestors imprisoned the beast in a magical vault that has been secured by five citadels in the Infernal Abyss.  I am to start procuring the keys from the tower of each citadel, beginning with the citadel called Spire.

In regards to the journal entry you uncovered in the Pinnacle Tower, I would take that to the Overseer.  She is best equipped for such matters.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]Aaah, so Aldus survived the five citadels.  According to his text, he is the one that destroyed the Pinnacle  key.  This bodes most favorably for us, my dear Guardian, for the destruction of the key has in fact made it easier for us to continue forward.

My curiosity and reservations are piqued with every text Aldus has left behind.  I shall put the entirety of my being into the study of Aldus' fate.  Of that, you have my word.

Take this, Guardian.  I wish I could do more to better prepare you for the coming tasks..

When you are ready to continue on your destined path, return to me.  We are now possessed with a final goal; one that you alone can accomplish.

I have managed to escape certain death, giving me hope for a final confrontation with the Shadowed God.  Only fate can guide me now... only fate can save us all...

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]The dawn of the final conflict is upon us and it will be you who will champion us through victory... or oblivion.

Discoveries made through your past efforts have indicated that this great evil has threatened us before, in a forgotten era of our city's great history. 

Centuries ago, five citadels were erected in the abyss to assure this being's containment, to prevent it from threatening our very existence.  As the eras passed, we forgot of these citadels and their purpose succumbed to the will of the malicious shadow.

The being's prison has been deteriorating for some time - how long exactly, we do not know.  According to the historian Aldus, the five citadels are believed to each contain a piece of the magical key that maintains the prison's barriers.

We are left with no choice but to confront the beast in his prison, but first, we must gain access to it. 

It is reasonable to believe that those who once imprisoned the creature are now its servants.  You must breach the five citadels and return each fragment of the key to me.

Use caution in this endeavor and remember that our survival depends on your success in this task.

source_text: I must speak with Overseer Lysetta.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I have spent more time on the writings of Aldus and the prophecy and have learned a great deal of the history that had once been forgotten.

The one we now know as the Shadowed God has resided in the depths of our world for countless millennia.  Our ancestors imprisoned the beast in order to protect our world and our existence from certain oblivion.

Those known as the Brotherhood of the Blade were the first champions of this cause.  They passed on the knowledge of the beast's prison to our ancestors.  It was then their sacred duty to safeguard the innocents and assure the Shadowed God's containment.

Throughout the passing eras, we forgot about the Brotherhood of the Blade.  We forgot our purpose.

In our years of neglect, the prison walls have weakened and the being's influence has begun to seep throughout our world.

Aldus and his companion discovered the truth of our past and they were successful in temporarily replenishing the prison, but if you do not succeed, their work and sacrifice will be for naught.

I know this is a terrible burden to place on you, but you were destined for this fate.   Do not despair from hope and you will be triumphant!

You know that you must return to Aven, but not without learning more about the power you have just unleashed...

source_text: I believe that my actions against the Cardinal Sentry have unleashed the Shadowed God on this world.  I had best search the Infernal Abyss and see if I can't catch up with him before he makes his way to Aven...

source_text:
[i_PI_LaylaGoodmorrow]By the grace of fate, you have survived.  There very well may be hope for us yet.

Here, take this.  I found it in the abyss not too long ago.  I am sure that you will be able to make more use of it than I.

Now, we must talk...

The elders of my tribe heard that you were making your way to confront the beast.  They sent me to follow you  in case you failed, but now is not the time to explain these actions.  Listen well and trust my words, for there is no time for details.

The Shadowed God has escaped.  I saw him with my own eyes and I assure you, a dangerous and seemingly impossible task lies ahead of you and your people.

I fear that the Shadowed God may have fled to your city, Aven.  However, it would be unwise for you to rush headlong into this unpredictable situation.

Madam Diana and her scouts are stationed in the Tornwood Forest.

They arrived in the forest shortly after you departed for this task.  I believe they are meant to be lookouts for your city.  It is obvious that even your fellow Avenites questioned the chance of your success.

But now is not the time for you to doubt yourself or question the motives of your brethren!  You must remain strong, for the battle has only begun.

You must make your way to Tornwood Forest.  Speak with Madam Diana before venturing to Aven.  Certainty before heroics, young Guardian.

I must go now.  I have my own people to warn and fight beside.  I trust that you will be able to make your way to Tornwood Forest on your own?  Yes?  Good.

Remember, you should speak with Madam Diana in the Tornwood Forest as soon as you arrive. She will be able to give you a full report of the Shadowed God and what chaos he has managed to wreak upon Aven and your people.

source_text:
Birds suddenly take flight from their perches in the autumn trees, their small black figures fluttering into the misty blue distance with all haste...

Madam Diana brings a finger to her lips, motioning for silence.  She tilts her head ever so slightly and her beautiful features strain in concentration.  She is listening in the silence, straining to catch the sound that caught her disciplined senses.

A faint sound finally emerges from the distance.  Screams of pain and terror rise out of the forest; the final cries of outcasts and scouts heralding the arrival of darkness...

[i_PI_MadamDiana]"The destruction begins...

"Go now, Guardian!  Stop him before all is lost!"

source_text:
[i_PI_AncientTome]My dear Aldus, I must break my promise to you, not because I fear the loneliness of your end, but I know you cannot do this alone.

[i_PI_Tael]Your spirit is strong and vibrant as the heavens, but even such a beacon of light cannot penetrate this darkness.

I must sacrifice myself beside you so that our pain and our struggles will not have been in vain.  I must do this for us; I must do this for our world.

I can only pray that the fates will guide our discoveries to the next champion; that Aven will one day be delivered from her hazed memory.

The ultimate success of our efforts resides upon chance alone, for our sacrifice will not ward the Shadowed God for long.

source_text:
[i_PI_Xoquoxxotil]The spirits of those before you were strong, but they faltered in holding me... until Aldus and Tael so bravely sacrificed themselves to strengthen the ward against me.  They alone spared this world for but a fragment of time.  And then you...

In all your ignorant glory, you unleashed the shackles that have bound me to this plane for so long.

I wonder, champion -- was this truly alone your doing?

No, those before you lent their hands to reaping this destruction upon your world.  Their arrogance has borne this oblivion unto all life and existence.

Challenge the fate that lies before you, but know that even in victory, all will be in vain!

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]The Crown, she has awakened from her coma and she is now a servant of the Shadowed God!  I do not know how this happened, but she is no longer our Crown...

Something... monstrous has taken hold of her.  She is lost to us.  I have failed her... we have failed her, Guardian.

When she turned, she began to slaughter innocents in the streets.  I confronted her, but she fled into the Eastern Catacombs before I could stop her.

The survival of Aven and protection of her people is now our only purpose!  I will remain here and fight off any more of the beast's servants.  Guardian, you must find Kaylee and end her tormented existence.

 I am sorry for this, more than you could ever know.

source_text: Kaylee has succumbed to the Shadowed God's allure.  She is no longer the Crown, but has since become something dark and evil.  When Templar Draven attempted to face her, she fled into the Eastern Catacombs.  I must find her.  I must stop her before anyone else succumbs to the darkness of these past hours...

source_text:
[i_PI_KayleeEvil1]Aaah, my Guardian returns!  I knew you would not disappoint me.

I feel pity for you... for all of you.  How hard you struggled to save me, and after all your efforts, after all your tears and sweat, everything was rendered for naught.

[i_PI_KayleeEvil2]I will tell you how -- I will tell you when you failed.  The Nethereye's curse was but a seed planted within me.  It was the Overseer's spell, devised from the Nethereye's own, that nurtured the corruption and bore me to my master.

[i_PI_KayleeEvil2]Do not despair this fate that has befallen me, for I have been given power and the truth of our collective end.  Aaah, but you do not despair.  Is this hope I sense within you still?

[i_PI_KayleeEvil3]Hahahaha!  After all your failures this day, you still retain hope!  How delightfully pathetic you are, Guardian.

There is nothing left for you beyond this fate.  Surrender yourself and I promise that you will know peace in oblivion.

source_text:
A deafening scream roars from the dispersing shadow of Kaylee's remains as she is released from the tormented grasp of the Shadowed God.

Silence then sweeps the cold halls as you mourn the loss of your precious and sacred ward.

Suddenly, a gentle warmth sweeps over you.  A delicate whisper speaks into the depths of your mind:

[i_PI_GoodKaylee]"Guardian, I beg of your forgiveness.  I am sorry for the pain I caused, I am sorry that I failed everyone... there are no words that I can say to atone for the pain that I caused you, my dear, sweet, brave Guardian..."

"Please, do not mourn my loss and do not blame yourself for the pain that once was.  You are needed now, more than ever before."

"Go now from this place of horrors.  Clear your mind and your heart of my loss.  I am free now.  I am at peace."

"The people of Aven need you now, dear Guardian.  Go to them and emerge victorious as our champion; this is the time of your destiny.  This is the time of Aven's triumph."

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]It is good to see you again, young Guardian, and know that I grieve for Kaylee's loss and hold no grudge against you.  The Crown was dear to us all.

There is no blame for what has occurred in the past hours.  We were all inadequately prepared and our naivete about the Crown's condition led to this.

I want you to seek the Elder.  The Overseer confided in him before she fled the city when the Shadowed God arrived.  My knights will remain prepared to face any more of the beast's attacks.

And Guardian?  You would do well to keep fast to that journal entry you found in Kaylee's clutches.  It was undoubtedly planted by the Shadowed God and the Overseer will have use for it as your task nears its end.

source_text:
[i_PI_AidasConcerned]Our dear, innocent Kaylee is lost to us.  This is a mournful tragedy, but one we must put behind us for the enemy has not yet been vanquished.

Overseer Lysetta gave me the transcripts of her work on the prophecy before she left the city.  You must listen now for the corruption erodes my body as we speak and I will soon be dead.

The four Masters of the Brotherhood are prophesied to return when all hope is lost and obliteration is feared imminent.  Now is that time and you must usher their return.

There are four sacred sites that are the final resting places of the Masters.  You must find each of these crypts and recover the urns that contain the Masters' ashes.

The first of these crypts, the Halls of Honor, resides beyond the depths of the Forgotten Catacombs beneath the city.

We are confident that this first tomb will provide answers regarding the location of the lost crypts.

Overseer Lysetta has already ventured into the outer territories in preparation for this task.  If the fates permit, you and she will be reunited at the fruition of your task.

You must be swift, hero.  The world depends upon your success.

The second master chose the earth as their tomb.  Nestled deep beneath the mines of the woodlands.  The Earthrest Crypts are home to the ashes of the second that are guarded by the undying Lunar Sage.

source_text:
[i_PI_DeanLysetta]I had hoped for your survival, young hero.

Thank you for saving this entry for me.  It would seem that Tael and Aldus once journied for the same ends that we now fight to achieve, and ultimately sacrificed themselves for the cause.

Do not be troubled by their fate, Guardian, for you will not need to make the same sacrifice.  What we hope to achieve is the total destruction of Xoquoxxotil to prevent the past from being remade in our future.

The Elysian Chamber is not far from here.  There is an ancient being, conjured by the forth master to safeguard the urn.  You must defeat the Phantom Savant in order to obtain the urn. 

I will be waiting here for your return.  Do not fail us, Guardian.  Everything depends upon your survival.

The Avatar of the four masters has awakened with the recovery of the urns.  He waits for you now in the Infernal Abyss.

Go to him and heed his wisdom.  May the fates be with us in these final hours.

source_text:
[i_PI_TheMasters]The Crown has fallen -- she who once guarded the withering prison has succumbed to the influence of the Shadowed God.

We weep for the innocent who is lost, but bear no pity toward the Champion's coming sacrifice.

Xoquoxxotil, the Shadowed God, has returned and all resides upon the brink of obliteration once more.

The Brotherhood of the Blade will fulfill the prophecy and bestow upon the Champion the Warden's Key; the key into the prison vault of the Shadowed God.  The key to triumph is granted, yet the fate of all remains uncertain.

Go forth to the Vaults and confront Xoquoxxotil.  This is our hour of fate.  This is your time to prove triumphant.

source_text:
[i_PI_TheMasters]Xoquoxxotil's demise has spared this world from oblivion.  The Champion's task is complete and their purpose has come to pass.

Now is the time for the world to emerge from atrophy and decay.  Life will return and the cycle begins anew.

The spirits of those who had served the prison guard are released into the infinity beyond this mortal world and shall know peace again.

Among them, the souls of Aldus and Tael, now forever united, forever together.

And the soul of Kaylee, no longer the vessel through which evil can enter our world.

Go now to your people, hero, and live the life that was once in peril.  Think no more on what could have been but live now in the world that you have brought to be.

source_text:
[i_PI_SabineFirehand]I have need of your services, if you are willing to provide them.

A number of berserkers have betrayed the sisterhood; abandoning the rule of Madam Diana and Aven for the freedom of the wilds.

Calipso, the matron of these rogue berserkers, took with her a sacred artifact tracing back to the origins of our ways.  This cannot be tolerated.

What you have to offer is a unique resilience and dedication that I think Calipso will find hard to twist in her favor.

I ask that you confront Calispo in her dismal lair and retrieve the totem.  Your efforts, should they prove fruitful, will be richly rewarded.

The Lost Researcher

source_text: It is common knowledge that the druids sacrifice themselves for the sake of returning the world to a state of natural purity, but Maia believes this suffering is unnecessary.  One of her researchers has gone missing in the Nightfall Tomb beneath the Shadowpine.  For the sake of Maia's research, I must venture into this sacred ground and save him.

source_text:
[i_PI_BradyReid]Oh, thank you!  Thank you so much for coming!

I don't know what happened!  All was clear when I entered, but I think I might have triggered a ward of some kind.

As soon as I reached this point, all these spirits started coming from the tombs!  Oh, you should have seen it!  It was so magnificent and terrible that I dropped my gate stone and it shattered.

Well, now that you're here, I think I'll just borrow that for a minute.  Now, let me see... aah, yes, here we are.  Now, I must get back!  Maia can be so unfavorable to those who are late.

source_text:
[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]I have heard a great deal about your heroism and strength, young warrior.  There is another victim that needs your help, and I hope that you are up to the dangers of the task.

I have spent the past years investigating the effects of druidic magic on the user's health.    I do not think the sacrifice or suffering the druids endure should be necessary and thus the focus of my research.

Three days ago, I sent one of the researchers to an ancient druidic burial site to gather more samples for my research.  I have not heard from them since their departure.

As you can imagine, I am worried for my researcher but more importantly, I am lost without the integral samples he was to gather.

I need you to go to the Nightfall Tombs and either save the researcher from certain peril, or recover whatever you can from his corpse.

[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]From what I am led to understand, you saved the researcher with little time to spare.  Remarkably done, Guardian!

As a show of my most sincere and deepest gratitude, I want you to take this.  It is a token, trifle really, but it should be adequate compensation for your time and effort.

Now, if you would be so kind as to go about your business.  I have quite a lot of work awaiting my undivided attention.

source_text:
[i_PI_SirArmon]I have received several reports of an apparition prowling the Splinterfull Woods.  The Shaelunn Maul believe this to be the spirit of a fallen knight known as Sir Braelynn.

It is only a matter of time before the spirit gathers its strength against us.  This cannot be allowed to happen.

Although we no longer hold animosity toward Sir Braelynn for his mortal past, the Shaelunn Maul's involvement would only strengthen the spirit's presence on the world.

This  is why we need you to perform this service.  Consider it an act of mercy, if it makes it easier for you.

The Fallen Knight

source_text:
[i_PI_SirBraelynn]Lower your blade, warrior.  I am threat to neither you, nor those whom have commanded my demise.

It is truth that I am not to be the cruel beast of legend.  My hands are clean but my name is fouled with the lies of my enemy.  My beloved wife, my cherished sons, all murdered... but not by my hand!

I seek only the relief of truth to be bestowed upon my falsely tainted name, and vengeance toward those whose hands are stained in the blood of my innocent beloved.

Confront Sir Gerard in the Deep Crypts guarded by the Forbidden Catacombs beneath the tavern floor.  Ensnared in the grips of his accursed hand, you will find the proof to reward your trust in my plight and to restore truth to the halls of Aven.

This testimony looks authentic and if it is indeed from the crypt of Sir Gerard, then it's likely to reverse a century-long injustice.

Well done, young hero.

source_text:
[i_PI_SabineFirehand]Madam Diana's scouts are reporting increased praetox activities in the Splinterfull Woods beyond the Shattercove.

It would seem that a new queen has been crowned and the praetox are regaining in strength and numbers.  Obviously, we must put a stop to their activities.

Being that you're the expert on praetox, shall we say... extermination, you are obviously the most logical candidate for this mission.

You will find the new nest in the tunnels beneath the Splinterfull Woods.

Take this for your efforts.  You've more than earned it.

source_text:
[i_PI_SirArmon]Many of our knights have suddenly disappeared since we first took to the badlands during the vrultok threat.

We always assumed that our knights had become victims of the vrultok necromancers, but we've recently come to learn of our mistake.  There is another enemy in the badlands; one that is both cunning and alluring.

The Weeping Banshee is the name of our enemy and she has been spotted luring our knights by Madam Diana's scouts.  She is a powerful and ancient siren whose madness and cruelty know no bounds.

We cannot allow this creature to continue her beguilement of our knights and scouts.  She must be stopped at once.

You will find her lair, called the Whispering Chasm, in the Waning Wastes.  Do not hesitate to strike down those who blindly serve and protect her.

source_text:
Introduction Passage:

Contained within the following pages is a detailed account of Aven's darkest history; a time when a tyrant rules our domain and her fanatic loyalists prowl the streets, the taverns, and our homes for dissenters.

Many keep quiet, fearful of the zealots that threaten them with exile; terrified of the world beyond the constricting safety of Aven's gates.  This is not a way of life. They have traded freedom and enlightenment for fear and oppression and it shall not be forgotten.

From the depths of carnage, shackled freedom, and the near-genocide of our ideals and passion, the wayfarers emerge.  Although we must roam far from her gates, we are and shall always be, the keepers of Aven's history, passion and beauty.

This is our testament.  This is our legacy.  [The rest of the tome is written in a language I do not understand.]

I will find this item in a chest as none of the undead have any interest in books.

source_text:
[i_PI_OldWoman]We meet again, champion, but it is not fate that has brought us face-to-face.

I have watched you for some time.   I have followed your struggles and triumph with great interest, and still you are ignorant to the foundation of your purpose.

Those beside whom you dwell call the wildlings thieves and scoundrels, when we are far more than you allow yourself to understand.

There is a deep history between our people; one that you must come to understand and accept as the champion of our world.

There is a place beneath the very streets of Aven that will help all of your people understand our joint past.

Go to the Long Walk and seek the Wayfarer's Testament.  Give that ancient text to your historians and I promise that you will all be wiser for it.

source_text:
[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]This is truly a remarkable find!  The history between the outcasts and Aven's people has been so clouded that we were never sure, but now we can delve into the truth.

From what I am able to gather, without formal research mind you, the outcasts--wildlings--were rebels who fought against a former tyrannical regime.  Our history, it would seem, is not as innocent as we had all believed.

Those who dared to stand against the tyrant were cruelly tortured and executed.  Those fortunate enough to escape fled the city walls and forged their own tribe.  Today, we know them as the Outcasts...

Of course there is more to be learned, but only through proper research will we uncover more of this lost history.

I will bring this before the scholars for immediate research.

source_text:
[i_PI_ShepherdGrailynn]I thank you, young champion.  The atrocities of our past are many, but we should not lose confidence or hope when faced with these grim truths.

To acknowledge the past is to possess the knowledge and possibility to better from it.

You had best return to your work on the prophecy.  My coven and I will begin our work on releasing these tormented spirits from their purgatory.

source_text:
[i_PI_ShepherdGrailynn]I do not wish to distract you from the larger matter at hand, but I would also hate for my silence to be responsible for another attack from within.

I have felt something dark stirring in the depths of our city.  There is suffering amidst this darkness; a vast, ancient pain that cries for release.

I have since come to learn that Aven was once wrought with civil unrest and ruled by tyrannical overlords.  In the ancient past, a prison full of political dissenters was flooded.

I believe that the Ancient Waterworks is the site of this atrocity and the tormented spirits within are the source of this pain.

You are the only one who can brave the unknown dangers of these forgotten districts.  If even your efforts should prove to only discredit my worries, I would be forever grateful for this service.

source_text:
The vrultok have not ceased their activities, despite their defeat.
Their necromancers continue to work to corrupt this world into a place of death and decay.  Shepherd Grailynn has asked that I lend my skills to vanquishing the necromancer known as the Scourge, who can be found in his lair atop the Necrosis Citadel in Deadeye Ridge.

[i_PI_Nethereye]Hissss.  You cannot hinder the shadow!  You cannot intervene in death!

To struggle against the inevitability of this world's demise is for naught.

source_text:
[i_PI_ShepherdGrailynn]We have come to learn that the destruction of the Nethereye was not enough to hinder their activities.

The vrultok necromancers continue their reverent worship of the shadow.  Their dark rituals are poisoning the very spirit of the earth, reversing centuries of our ancestors' work.

We must put a stop to their dark rituals.  A vrultok necromancer known only as The Scourge has risen from the ashes of the Nethereye's death.  It is through this fiend's command and will that the corruption is born.

You must destroy this fiend if we are to preserve the purity of our world.  I believe that you will find him in the Necrosis Citadel, in a chamber that had once been secret to us.

Make haste, young hero, and may the fates' guide you to victory.

source_text:
[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]Something truly remarkable has befallen us, young warrior, and I need your help to claim our find.

Through further investigation of the vrultok people, we have learned that they possess a piece of an ancient artifact my own father searched his entire life for.

Legends say that during times now lost to us, the people of Aven had a magnificent weapon in their possession.  This legendary weapon saved our people from our strongest enemies for centuries.

Somehow, the weapon was lost to us, but not anymore.  I believe we have found the weapon in the possession of the vrultok.  Certainly, we cannot let them utilize this power, but more importantly, we must reclaim it for our own defenses.

You alone can brave the dangers of the Screeching Halls and recover the weapon.

source_text:
[i_PI_Csuragual]I have need of you, champion.  An ancient enemy is growing in power and our existence is threatened.

For so long have we held the sirens at bay, but the rise of the Shadowed God has made them more powerful and their threat has become far too real to be ignored.

One siren in particular, known as Megarra, prowls the Eclipsed Lands, intent on enslaving the dragons of that region.  The power of dragonkind cannot be let to fall into the hands of the siren witch!

You are strong enough to stop her, for you have the will and power to resist their call.  This has already been proven so.

Your success in this endeavor shall not go overlooked.  Of this, you have my word.

[i_PI_ShepherdGrailynn]I am glad to see you, hero.  There is a situation of dire concern and I am in need of your assistance.

The druids have been investigating the natural wonders of the frozen tundra in order to learn of the lost world around us.  However, as you well know, even this once secluded realm has caught the cruel attentions of the shadow...

One of my pupils, who was investigating the Glacial Steppes, has succumbed to the shadowed infection and now he serves the great evil plaguing our world.  He now calls himself Blightfallow and rampages throughout the steppes, destroying everything in his path.

You must find his remains and end this senseless corruption.  His spirit cannot be allowed to continue in the service of the shadow -- if not for his sake, then for the sake of the tundra, you must take action.

There is a place of flawless natural perfection - a place that has survived the many horrors and atrocities of our world unscathed.  We wish access to the Glimmering Caves, to study and preserve it.

It is unfortunate that we cannot do so in peace, for this place resides in the territory of a most formidable dragon.  We have tried to reason with him, but to no avail.

I am afraid that the greater good must be served.  You must dispatch the dragon so that we can safely investigate his domain.

The Temple of Nightmares is the current residence of the tome.  There is only one among us who has proven formidable against the sirens -- you.

If you would be so inclined as to oblige my needs, your deed will be generously rewarded.

source_text:
[i_PI_Draven]Now that the Shadowed Beast has been vanquished, we can turn our attention to the prisons in the Infernal Abyss.

We know that the Shadowed God was not the only being to have been imprisoned by our ancestors.

The once kings and queens of our ancient enemies reside in the deepest oubliettes of those citadels.

Now that the barrier has been broken and the Shadowed God destroyed, there is a chance that these beings may escape their prison and rise against us.

It is imperative that we eliminate any possibility of their escape.  Begin with the Meridian oubliette and move your way across the Abyss, destroying those who would seek future aggression against us.

source_text:
[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]That took longer than expected, but late is better than not arriving at all!

Here, take this for your services.  Now, go on and be on your way.  I'm sure there's beasties for you to slay or lost innocents to save... you know, heroic, adventurous and suicidal things that you seem so interested in.  I've got to begin my research on the tome at once!

source_text:
[i_PI_AlchemistMaia]There you are!  I was beginning to grow a bit impatient...

Impatient?  Did I say impatient?  I meant worried.  I'm just so distracted, you understand of course.

Now that you're here, I can finally continue my research of Aven's history.  I have narrowed the location of the second volume of the Tome of Aven to Pandemonium's Gate.  I don't trust anyone else but you to recover it for me.  Anyone else would surely get themselves killed and the tome incinerated...

Well, what are you waiting for?  I'd like to be able to complete this research as quickly as possible so I can move on to other matters still awaiting my expertise.  Go.  Go.

source_text:
[i_PI_Beholder]Another Guardian aproaches?  It seems like only yesterday that I faced Aven's champion...

Aaah, but I am incorrect!  The researcher and his woman were not Guardians.  How intriguing!  I feel almost... defeated, for you see, they triumphed here where today, you shall fall.

It is a pity that you arrive now, so late indeed, Guardian.  Our power is too strong!  There is not even hope of a decent struggle!  And I had so hoped that oblivion's arrival would be as marvellous as I had dreamed...

Alas, I must settle for the more tame destruction of your people.

source_text:
[i_PI_AncientTome]We prepare tonight for my venture into the five citadels.  The horrors that await are beyond my comprehension, but we are undoubtedly heading into a most hazardous and dark chapter in our quest.

[i_PI_Aldus]Should I survive the ordeal, I will be but one step closer to purging this world from the dark nemesis that threatens all life on Unataca.

After much convincing, I have reasoned with Tael and she will remain behind as the keeper and messenger of our collective findings.  If I should fail, she is the last beacon of hope for Aven.  They alone can succeed in the event of my failure else all will perish to oblivion...

But look, now you've gone and proven me wrong! Thank you for that, Guardian, and I'm sorry that I doubted you.

Oh, and by the way, you owe me 100 gold pieces for making me lose my bet with Price over there.  Yeah, I bet against you, but can you really blame me?

You are truly a remarkable individual and I am honored to have been of assistance to the greatest hero of our time.

Do not despair at his loss.  His body has been buried in the Infernal Abyss, as was his wish.  From his ashes, the seed of a new era of life and purity will be born.  No finer honor could have been bestowed upon him, of that I promise you.

source_text: Kaylee is safe again, but not everyone was so fortunate.  I should speak with the Overseer and lend my services wherever possible.

structural_fields.english_text: Kaylee is safe again, but not everyone was so fortunate.  I should speak with the Overseer and lend my services wherever possible.

source_text: I was able to gather an ancient tome from the ruins of the city's former library, but I am not certain if the Overseer was able to make use of the find.  I should check with her and see if there's anything else she needs me to do.

source_text: The Overseer assures me that she will be able to create an antidote before any permanent damage is done to either her or Kaylee.  In the meantime, she has asked that I speak with Elder Aidas.

structural_fields.english_text: The Overseer assures me that she will be able to create an antidote before any permanent damage is done to either her or Kaylee.  In the meantime, she has asked that I speak with Elder Aidas.

source_text: I haven't heard from the Academy in some time.  I hope that everyone is faring well since the attack, especially Kaylee.  I know that she is strong, but being abducted by praetox and held captive by strange, shadow-speaking zombies would affect even the strongest of us.
